quest.title: Irodori Poetry: Part II
quest.description: Lenne is busy writing a new poem and appears to need your help once again...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x4, Wanderer's Advice x8

talks.objective: Wait till the next morning (08:00 – 12:00) and talk to Ootomo

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I've heard that flying as free as the wind is the dream of all people from Mondstadt. Honestly, I'd say that this phrase suits Lenne very well indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: It's just a shame that I didn't enjoy going out as a child. If I had a companion like you then, I might actually have a gliding license now.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mister}, wonderful timing! Lenne and I were just working on a new poem.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Need my help in getting some inspiration again?

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Haha, that's right. Under Ootomo's instruction, I've been composing another poem with an Inazuman style, although admittedly I'm still quite the amateur.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: The theme of this poem is "friendship," and indeed both of us can only lament that we did not meet sooner. One of the lines I would like to write depicts animals wandering the landscape in companionship with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Since this is an Inazuman poem, we must reference <color=#00E1FFFF>creatures unique to these lands</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We do see animals unique to Inazuma pretty often — whether it be ones that walk or fly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But since they all appear out in the wild, let's head out and search for them, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: I am in your debt! Please help me take <color=#00E1FFFF>4</color> photos of different animals from Inazuma, then.

talks.objective: Prepare 4 photos of Inazuman regional animals related to the theme

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Do you have the pictures ready, friend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here they are.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Let me see... Oh, these are great! I think I know what to write now.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: I have written a few more versions of a stanza based on the pictures that you brought. Why don't you pick the one we should use once again?

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I've heard that crossing rivers and seas takes a great deal of time. But if I had a friend with me, I'm sure it would be a glad time.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Friend, since both you and Ootomo love this phrase so, then let us use it.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Lenne's poem and the pictures complement each other a lot. Honestly, the poem just gets more and more moving as you read it and look at the images.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: To be honest, I have also been writing a poem for which I might need your aid tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need me to take some pictures, too?

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Heh, let's talk about it in more detail tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Hehe, if Lenne and I had met when we were younger, we might have gone on romps outdoors just like those crabs and lizards.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Inazuman children often gather together to tell tales of youkai to test each others' courage. These experiences also become precious memories when they have grown up.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: I didn't expect that Lenne would be able to connect that to the pictures of these creatures. This stanza has deep meaning indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Do you have the pictures ready, friend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet...

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: No worries. We just need <color=#00E1FFFF>4 pictures of Inazuman animals</color> today. Thanks a lot!
